says: What each place has written down as documents - what it is, how to work in it, what it has specified: each file a row, and how it begins. Read where a place is held. All of it is taken in: what is said in a document is said too.
Who takes part: a person or an agent, what they are called, and the other names they go by - so that what waits on someone can be drawn.

Where everything lives: every surface something of this work is kept on - in a place or outside any - what shape it holds there, how it is read now, and what is lacking for it to be read. So that what the ecosystem does not yet consume is in view, beside what it does.
The perfect form of the whole, from each angle it has been described - and beside it what the lenses show of each now: how the whole stands to its own idea, read off and not said.
